title: Active and Inactive show as a badge on the list and gray text on the page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B, with no category.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Open matrix B's page from the Matrices list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A shows an Active badge.
  • Matrix B shows an Inactive badge.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's title shows its name.
  • Nothing shows beside the name.

Step 3:

  • Matrix B's page shows Inactive as plain gray text beside the name.
  • The gray text reads "Inactive: No categories use this matrix".
